string.text: All right, all right, we give up! We just wanted to make friends... our way. Show a little kindness.
Okay, okay! We surrender! Just don't call Fluttershy, she's got The Stare!
We surrender! Pony promise — cross my heart and hope to fly, stick a cupcake in my eye!
Fine, you win. Can we at least keep the cupcakes?
We give up! Call it a friendship lesson — for us. We've learned it, honest.
Don't hit us! We actually wanted to be Wonderbolts, but they wouldn't take us...
Our friendship is stronger than your swords! You'll never take us alive![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Surrender? Do we look like ponies who surrender? Well, maybe a little... But not today![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Twenty percent cooler — and charge! Attack![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
You want our horseshoes? Come and take them![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Never! We'll hold on like Applejack to the last apple![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
So that's how it is? Fine — I'll show at least one of you what real friendship feels like![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
And you call that harmony?! All right, then — here's a lesson you won't forget![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
That's it! Somepony's about to get bucked so hard their cutie mark falls off![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
No mercy? Then don't expect any cupcakes or greeting cards from us either![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Well, that's just fine! Friendly roads to you!
Thank you, kind pony! We're off... to find somepony easier.
You won't regret it! Probably. We'll send you a card. Maybe.
We're going, we're going! Not a word to anypony, okay? Especially the Royal Guard.
Wait, wait... Where are you off to, friend? We're not done yet.
Not so fast, Rainbow Dash! We haven't finished talking.
Hey, hey, hey, the party's not over yet! Pinkie would be hurt.
Leaving already? What about a parting gift? Your purse, for instance.
You! You scattered all my friends! Let's settle this fair — one on one, like old friend-enemies.
You wrecked my hideout and scared off my crew. Face me one on one — let's see whose cutie mark is tougher!
Not bad for a tourist. Now try me — no entourage, hoof to hoof.
You ruined our whole party! Want to finish it? One on one, then!
Friendship is magic, traveler. Ours just bites. Keep moving.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
You have no idea how strong our friendship is. Want to feel it on your own hide?[if:convo_bared_teeth]
We're having a friendship picnic here. Uninvited guests aren't welcome.
Smile, traveler! The last one who didn't is still looking for his horseshoes.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Love and tolerance, remember? We're still tolerating. Don't test us.[if:convo_angry]
We're just a bunch of best friends... very hungry best friends.
Touch one of us and you deal with all of us. That's the kind of friends we are.[if:convo_aggressive]
Harmony is you going your way and us going ours. Let's do that.
There are more of us than it looks. Behind that hill our friends are waiting — a lot of friends.
What do you want? If you came for friendship — ours costs money.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
One more step and your cutie mark becomes a target.[if:convo_bared_teeth]
We're not bandits, we're... cutie mark crusaders. Right now we're crusading for the 'robbed a traveler' mark.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Careful! Our boss once ate an entire cake of Princess Celestia's. By himself. Without asking.
Did you just walk out of the Everfree? Timberwolves say hello more politely.
The Great and Powerful Trixie says: no autographs and no fights!
We're counting pebbles for the Diamond Dogs. Don't interrupt, or we'll lose count and get upset.[if:convo_angry]
Our orders: treat every stranger to cupcakes. Only our cupcakes are... special. Like Pinkie's on a dark day.[if:convo_bared_teeth]
Stay back! We've got parasprites on a leash here, and they're hungry.
Heard of the sonic rainboom? You're about to hear one right next to your ear.[if:convo_aggressive]
Think Nightmare Moon is just a foal's tale? We'll show her to you in your nightmares.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Leave while you can. Even an Ursa Minor doesn't mess with us.
Hey! This is a private apple field. Well, it was private... until yesterday.
Just passing through. Like Flim and Flam — only without the cider and with clubs.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Be glad it's not Nightmare Night. We wouldn't be talking then.
Halt, traveler! Feel the power of our friendship! Or share your purse — friends share, after all.[if:convo_bared_teeth]
Now that's friendly! Show us what you've got.
See how easy friendship is? Safe travels, pal!
Won't be friends the nice way? Then we'll be friends the hard way![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Hey, pony! We're collecting donations for the friendship fund. Contributions are mandatory.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Generosity is one of the Elements of Harmony. Let's see how generous you are.
Now that's generosity! Rarity herself would be proud of you. Now scram.
Being stingy isn't friendly. We'll teach you that right now![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
What a meeting! We were just looking for new friends. And their gold.[if:convo_bared_teeth]
Good pony. New friends always bring gifts.
The best gift is a gift from a friend. Run along while we're feeling nice.
No gift, then? Then you get a friendship lesson — with a hoof![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Stop right there! Friendship is magic, and magic is expensive these days. Pay up or regret it.[if:convo_aggressive]
Sensible. Let's discuss the price of our friendship.
A pleasure doing business with you. Until next time, friend!
Have it your way! Now you'll learn the true power of our friendship![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Gotcha! Don't worry, we're nice. Until you get greedy.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
That's the spirit. Hand over whatever you've got in there.
See? Everypony's still friends. Go on and spread the harmony.
Getting greedy after all... Friends, with me![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Not one step further! The law of friendship rules this road: what's yours is everypony's.[if:convo_aggressive]
That's right. Sharing is fun!
Now we're real friends. Ride on.
Won't share? Then we'll take it ourselves — the whole friendly gang![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Smile, pal! This is a robbery, but a very friendly one.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Let's settle this peacefully, like real friends.
Friendship wins! And you're free to go.
Fine, the friendly way didn't work. This is going to hurt![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Look, a lonely traveler. It's so sad being alone... Let us lighten your load.[if:convo_bared_teeth]
Then we have a deal. Show us that load.
Walking's easier now, isn't it? Don't mention it, friend.
You asked for it. We're about to surround you with care — from every side![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Halt! The Flim Flam Brothers present: the Super Speedy Coin Collector 6000! Only one purse![if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Excellent choice, valued customer! Guaranteed — right up to the next bend in the road.
Thank you for your purchase! Complaints accepted in Manehattan. Probably.
No refunds. Beatings, however, are included![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Aha! The Great and Powerful Trixie foretold it: today you part with your money![if:convo_bared_teeth]
A wise decision. The stars approve. So does Trixie.
The show is over! You may keep your applause — but not your coins.
Don't believe in prophecy? Then watch the 'vanishing traveler' trick![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Stop! This is a Diamond Dog checkpoint. One shiny to pass. No shinies — then you dig.[if:convo_aggressive]
Shinies? Give them here, give them here! Dogs love shinies.
Good shinies. Go on through while we sniff them.
No shinies — take a shovel! Or take a beating![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Don't move! We accidentally spilled cupcakes here, and there's a fine for every one you squash. You've squashed three already.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
Now that's fair. Cupcakes paid for, no complaints.
Enjoy! Just watch your hooves next time.
Won't pay for the cupcakes? Then you'll work them off — in bruises![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Gotcha, little pegasus... oops, I mean pony! A sonic rainboom won't save you — we've got nets strung up.[if:convo_bared_teeth]
Hold still and it'll be over faster than a good Wonderbolts flyby.
Fly... I mean, walk. We took twenty percent of your coolness.
Want to see who's faster? We'll test your ribs![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Hush, traveler... Nightmare Moon has returned, and she demands tribute. Through us, that is.[if:convo_bared_teeth]
Good. The night is kind to those who pay.
Sleep well. If you can.
Not afraid of the dark? It's about to get very dark![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Hey, farmer! This year's zap apple harvest is ours. Along with your money.[if:convo_aggressive]
Now that's neighborly. Granny Smith would approve. Probably.
We'll mail you some zap apple jam. Maybe.
Won't hand over the harvest? Then we'll gather it ourselves — straight off your hide![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
